similarities.claim: Uses a concise repository map so the model can reason about code beyond the files currently being edited.

differences.claim: Optimized for interactive pair programming rather than durable project governance.

lessons_for_afol.lesson: Expose compact, ranked project context so agents do not need to read broad docs before acting.

do_not_copy.reason: Do not optimize only for chat-driven coding; AFOL also needs durable governance state and validation.

source_refs.title: Aider repository map
source_refs.claim: Aider documents a concise repository map containing important classes, functions, types, and call signatures within a token budget.
